# camera-gpio-interface-pcb

<!-- Generated by orb-weaver-kicad-docs (scripts/board_view.py); do not edit. -->

Camera GPIO interface for the three FLIR Blackfly S cameras of the joystick rig: three pluggable screw-terminal camera channels, two BNC inputs from the pyControl breakout, four 3.3 V BNC outputs to a Neuropixels OneBox, an InstrumentPort-Digital-50 with every camera line tapped, USB power; no MCU; v1.0 as built.

The assembled board with its design blocks numbered. On the site the picture is a model that turns, or the top
render where WebGL is absent, and each number is a link to the block's page: its schematic, parts, ports and
placement guidance. Read on the forge, the picture is the plain top render and the table below is the key.
